title: Bridging the Digital Gap: AI Sign Language Interpretation Solution
summary: Baidu reports that XiLing provided round-the-clock sign-language coverage during the 2022 Winter Olympics, with over 100 million live and replay views.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Baidu reports that XiLing provided round-the-clock sign-language coverage during the 2022 Winter Olympics, with over 100 million live and replay views. Winter Olympics broadcasting / product rollout. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Make spoken and written information accessible through sign-language output.
system: Baidu XiLing AI sign-language interpretation platform

ratings.reason: The source reports round-the-clock sign-language Olympic coverage reaching viewers. This supports expanded access to content, without treating view counts as proof of comprehension or lasting inclusion.
Broadcasters gained continuous AI sign-language output for a major event. The gain is service capability; comparative cost savings are not given.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Bridging the Digital Gap: AI Sign Language Interpretation Solution

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Speech and sign-language models with linguistic input

headline: AI sign-language broadcasting at the Winter Olympics

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
